净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： This preserves the parent’s overnight-versus-intraday price-discovery mechanism while replacing a hard 63-day cutoff with exponentially weighted smoothing. Recent repricing leadership receives more weight, while gradual decay of older observations should reduce window-boundary instability and target stronger IC consistency without adding a second signal family.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

[ewm_mean(63, overnight_return) - ewm_mean(63, intraday_return)] / ewm_mean(63, |overnight_return| + |intraday_return|)
依赖列: open, close

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) overnight_ret = (open - ts_delay(close, 1)) / ts_delay(close, 1) 隔夜收益
  2. 2) abs(overnight_ret) 跳空幅度
  3. 3) ts_rank(volume, 20) 当前量能分位
  4. 4) (1 - ts_rank) 不活跃度
  5. 5) score = abs(隔夜) × 不活跃度 隔夜跳空但没人接盘 → 风险
  6. 6) smoothed = ema(span=10, score)
  7. 7) 取负后 cs_rank
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_overnight_repricing_ewm_stability(df): """Measures recency-weighted leadership of overnight repricing over intraday returns.""" df_copy = df.copy() overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) overnight_ewm = overnight_ret.ewm(span=63, min_periods=63, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() intraday_ewm = intraday_ret.ewm(span=63, min_periods=63, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() activity_ewm = (overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).ewm(span=63, min_periods=63, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_overnight_repricing_ewm_stability"] = (overnight_ewm - intraday_ewm) / activity_ewm "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_overnight_repricing_ewm_stability"]
